hypotheses.paper: a causality (defi:causalite, ETT.tex:238 'a sheaf on M with values in C'; 'equivalently' form ETT.tex:245-251)
hypotheses.note: the 'equivalently' form (Causality, no gluing, kb/0014). The plain witness deuxPushup is built with Causality.ofRelation and is not absolutely minimal; it cannot be (finding 1)
lightlikeLine; proved here also causal and absolutely minimal

findings: ETT.tex:316 (and 303-304, 'logically independent'): 'neither implies the other' holds in the 'equivalently' form of defi:causalite (ETT.tex:245-251) only through a causality that is not absolutely minimal. On a T1 (a fortiori Hausdorff) space, an absolutely minimal causally plain causality has the push-up property of defi:pushup (Lean: Causality.pushUp_of_causallyPlain_of_absolutelyMinimal; on an open subset, pushUpOn_of_causallyPlainOn_of_absolutelyMinimalOn). Proof: absolute minimality against the cover {M∖{y}, M∖{z}} makes y ≪_U z factor as y ≪_U w ≪_U z (interpolatesOn_of_absolutelyMinimalOn); given x ≤_U y ≪_U z, the open set I^+_U(y) ∩ I^-_U(z) ∋ w lies in Int J^+_U(x) ⊂ closure I^+_U(x) by plainness, so some v has x ≪_U v ≪_U z (pushUpOn_of_causallyPlainOn_of_interpolatesOn). The paper's examples (Minkowski space, the static spacetimes and E_alpha, every causality generated from local ones by theo:causalite_engendre, hence the singular flat spacetimes) are absolutely minimal, so on all of them causal plainness implies push-up. If 'sheaf' (ETT.tex:238) carries a gluing condition, which for these covariant (extension-map) data means the relations on U are generated by those on any open cover of U, i.e. absolute minimality of every open subset, then the converse half of the remark is false for every topological spacetime. Witness of the true half in the gluing-free reading: deuxPushup on ℝ, causal, causally plain, -2 ≤ -1 ≪ 1 and not -2 ≪ 1 (deuxPushup_causallyPlain, deuxPushup_not_pushUp, deuxPushup_isCausal, deuxPushup_not_absolutelyMinimal).

ETT.tex:318-320 ('silent at a point whose causal future or past has empty interior'): this is not the mechanism and does not yield an example. At a point x with Int J^+_U(x) = ∅ the future clauses of defi:pushup at x hold too, vacuously (I^+_U(x) = ∅ = I^+_U(J^+_U(x)); Causality.pushUp_future_of_interior_Jplus_eq_empty, past: pushUp_past_of_interior_Jminus_eq_empty). Any failure x ≤_U y ≪_U z, not x ≪_U z, has z ∈ Int J^+_U(x) and y ∈ Int J^-_U(z) (mem_interior_Jplus_of_le_of_lt, mem_interior_Jminus_of_lt_of_le). What plainness leaves open is the gap between I^+_U(x) and its closure (it gives z ∈ closure I^+_U(x), mem_closure_Iplus_of_le_of_lt_of_causallyPlain), and only a chronological relation without interpolation (y ≪ z with I^+(y) ∩ I^-(z) = ∅) reaches into it. Suggested wording: exhibit the example, or say 'causal plainness only places I^+(J^+(x)) in the closure of I^+(x)'.

ETT.tex:322-324: the density sentence of the second paragraph is the one already recorded under prop:K_plongement_ordre (push-up gives density of I^-(x) in J^-(x) only together with J^-(x) ⊂ Z^-, Jminus_subset_closure_Iminus_of_pushUp; the spacelike line has push-up and no density). Not restated here.

Which 'push-up': the remark names defi:pushup (ETT.tex:307), the relational property, and that is the one formalized (Causality.PushUp). ETT.tex:209-210 and 290 call causal plainness itself 'the push-up property'; read that way the converse would compare plainness with itself. Already recorded under rem:pas_plat; repeated because it is the reading this remark depends on.
questions: defi:causalite (ETT.tex:238) says 'a sheaf on M with values in C' and then gives an 'equivalently' form (ETT.tex:245-251) without any gluing condition. Is a causality meant to glue, i.e. are the relations on U generated by those on the members of any open cover of U (absolute minimality of every open subset)? Reading taken: the 'equivalently' form, as the library's Causality carries it (kb/0014). Under it the remark's independence is certified; under the gluing reading its converse half is false (finding 1). The label is left unmarked until this is ruled.

Is a chronological relation without interpolation (y ≪ z with nothing chronologically between them, as -1 ≪ 1 in deuxPushup) meant to be admissible? Reading taken: yes; nothing in defi:categorie_C or defi:causalite excludes it, and it is exactly what the converse independence needs.

kb_proposals: Causal plainness plus absolute minimality on a T1 space gives push-up (Causality.pushUp_of_causallyPlain_of_absolutelyMinimal, CausalScaffold.DeuxPushup): there is no local (absolutely minimal) causality that is plain without push-up, so do not look for one; a witness needs a chronological relation without interpolation, hence Causality.ofRelation (T-ett-deux-pushup).
Absolute minimality on a T1 space makes every ≪_U interpolate: apply Precausality.AbsolutelyMinimalOn.exists_lt_inf with O = {z}ᶜ (Causality.interpolatesOn_of_absolutelyMinimalOn).

A cheap open transitive relation on ℝ: a ≪ b iff φ a < ψ b with ψ ≤ φ, φ upper and ψ lower semicontinuous; build φ, ψ from id plus indicators (IsClosed.upperSemicontinuous_indicator, IsOpen.lowerSemicontinuous_indicator, IsClosed.lowerSemicontinuous_indicator with a value ≤ 0) and get open sections from isOpen_preimage. Interpolation fails across a jump of the generic time (DeuxPushup.phi, DeuxPushup.psi).

CausalScaffold.lean (the scaffold root) was not edited, per dispatch, so the module is invisible to the axiom sweep until the master imports it or graduates it (kb/0025). Recommendation: rem:deux_pushup stays partial and unmarked, with decls Causal.deux_pushup (independence, library reading) and Causal.deux_pushup_absolutelyMinimal (the asymmetry under absolute minimality), pending an OQ on the gluing reading of defi:causalite. The file could graduate whole (no sorry); its general lemmas (interpolation, plain + interpolation ⇒ push-up, lightlike line absolutely minimal, ofRelation_causallyPlain) have nothing to do with the reading. Side remark for the master: since plain ⇒ push-up for absolutely minimal T1 spacetimes, results stated under push-up apply under plainness on every absolutely minimal spacetime.
